subject: Welcome to the team - a first-day note from Alex Rivera
body:
Hi and welcome!

We're excited that you're joining the team today. I wanted this note to come =
from me directly so it doesn't get lost with routine system notifications.

A few quick first-day steps:
  1. Reply to this email so I know you received it.
  2. Check your calendar for onboarding sessions and your team intro.
  3. If anything is missing or confusing, reply here and I'll help.

We're glad you're here, and I'm looking forward to working with you.

Best,
Alex Rivera

subject: System Notice: Routine Health Check
body: All internal deployment and monitoring services operational.
